title: Pulse Ridges
description: White ridgelines recede to the horizon as solid, rim-lit terrain. Music swells and folds it; each raised hand on Source B lifts its own peak. Line colour is adjustable.

parameters.label: Pulse
parameters.description: A wave of light rolling from the front ridge to the horizon.

parameters.label: Flow
parameters.description: How fast the terrain flows toward the viewer.

parameters.label: Body Lift
parameters.description: How much each raised hand lifts its own peak.

provenance.prompt_summary: Stacked ridge lines in perspective: bass lifts the peaks, melody roughens the terrain, treble glints along the crests and attacks ripple from front to back.
